note: Texts as v2; only the audio tags in [brackets] are new (performance directions, not spoken: every line was checked with speech-to-text, scribe_v1). Delivery is slower and closer than v2 (lines are 20–70 % longer); the intro timing table in sound.js was re-timed.

lines.v-wait: [softly] Place your hands on the wall to begin.
lines.v-intro-1: [hushed, intimate] For more than two hundred years, in the squares of Catalonia, people have built towers.
lines.v-intro-2: [hushed] No stone. No rope. Only bodies, one standing on another, as high as ten storeys. They call them castells.
lines.v-intro-3: [softly] A castell is not built by the ones who climb. It is built by the ones below: hundreds of hands, pressed together, holding.
lines.v-intro-4: [whispers] Tonight, these walls are the square. And you are the pinya.
lines.v-intro-5: [slowly, softly] Strength. Balance. Courage. Good sense.
lines.v-intro-6: [softly] Put your hands on the wall.
lines.v-brasa-1: [hushed] Every castell begins in the dark, with a single touch. Touch the wall.
lines.v-pinya-1: [warm, hushed] First, strength. The pinya is the base: bodies pressed so close that they become one. Find a circle, and hold it.
lines.v-tronc-1: [hushed, steady] Now, balance. Floor by floor, each one stands on the shoulders of the one below. Listen to the drum, and press on the beat.
lines.v-tronc-2: [softly] Keep the tower straight. Hold both sides.
lines.v-pom-1: [whispers] Now, courage. The smallest climb last. The square holds its breath.
lines.v-pom-2: [whispers] Hold still, and carry her light.
lines.v-aleta-1: [awed, softly] She raises her hand. The castell is crowned.
lines.v-baixada-1: [softly] But a castell is only complete when it comes down. Good sense. Stay with it, floor by floor.
lines.v-cierre-descarregat: [warmly] Descarregat. Raised, crowned, and brought down safely.
lines.v-cierre-carregat: [softly] Carregat. Crowned, and then it fell.
lines.v-cierre-intent: [softly] It fell before the crown. In the squares they call that an intent. And they try again.
lines.v-cierre-final: [tender, hushed] This was your castell. When bodies resonate together, culture is born.
